title: The Late Radiators
author: Felix Nystrom
blurb: Hazel Marchetti, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
